---
title: "JAMA Network Open publishes AI-triggered trial notification study"
description: "A randomized trial of emailing oncologists about matching trials when AI detects cancer progression."
date: 2025-04-21
---

Our study, [Clinical Trial Notifications Triggered by Artificial Intelligence–Detected Cancer Progression](https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jamanetworkopen/fullarticle/2833029), is out in JAMA Network Open.

Patients often become eligible for a new trial when their cancer progresses. In this randomized trial at Dana-Farber, run from January 2023 to June 2024, AI applied to imaging reports detected likely progression, and the patient's oncologist received an email about genomically matched trials.

The AI reliably spotted patients likely to need a new treatment, but the notifications did not increase trial enrollment. That result shaped the design of the follow-up study, [OPTIONS-ACTIVATE](2026-options-activate.qmd).
